{n} pulled a face with everything behind it on the stage of the premiere. A critic in the audience noted: 'mysterious Oriental'.

After this, music's centre of gravity moves from the intricate counterpoint of the Baroque to a new, bright, singing style. The sound of your orchestra was remembered as the bridge between them.
In 1789 the French Revolution breaks out. Court orchestras vanish one after another, and music moves to the concert halls where citizens gather.
Before long, railways join city to city and virtuosos travel farther still. The age of the virtuoso reaches its height from here.
The quarrel between Wagnerians and Brahmsians is handed on to the next generation: to Mahler and Richard Strauss.
In 1914 the First World War begins. Many musicians are torn apart by frontiers, and an age comes to an end.
